name: Conchean
text: Conchean is a variant spelling of Coinchenn. Coinchenn is the monstrous, dog-headed wife of Morgan and mother of Delbcháem. The PCE article on her sits at Coinchenn. See Coinchenn.

okr.objective: Conchean is a variant spelling that points to Coinchenn.
key_results: MacKillop records Conchean as a variant of Coinche(a)nn.
Coinchenn is the dog-headed wife of Morgan.
The main PCE article sits at Coinchenn.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. 'Conchean' (2008).
